description: Use this before you talk about or change a plan, and when the person asks about its rooms, sizes, areas or square footage. Returns the facts that the planner computes for the site and for a floor or every floor: the site's location, time zone and north, rooms with areas and sizes, what each door connects, window directions, routes from the entrance, and warnings.

floor.description: The floor to describe, 0 for the ground floor; every floor when left out.

project_id.description: The project's ID from list_projects or create_project. It is an internal key: people know their plans by title.

name: describe_plan
title: Describe plan
